frozen_identity.question: Will OpenRouter process at least 775T tokens from Oct 26 to Nov 22?
frozen_identity.literal_rule: Sum of the Top Models chart weekly totals for weeks Oct 26, Nov 2, Nov 9, Nov 16 2026; UTC Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:59. Each week updates until next week first appears. Resolve from these four totals once Nov 23 week first displayed; if not displayed by Nov 27 2026 11:59 PM ET use totals then. Chart rounding applies; exact bracket boundary resolves higher. Source OpenRouter rankings.

primary_source_facts.fact: The page snapshot reports data through Oct 19, 2026. Frozen market target weeks begin Oct 26, 2026 and end Nov 22, 2026; those target dates are future at capture, so this snapshot supplies no target-week observations.
